title: Why NHCP pauses Oslob's sports center project, heritage rules explained

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — A planned sports and cultural center in Oslob has run into heritage protection rules that restrict construction in historic plazas, prompting the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) to order work suspended. The commission has yet to clear the proposed facility, citing the town plaza’s historical significance, nearby heritage landmarks, and restrictions on covered structures in protected public spaces. The dispute also involves Oslob’s Old Municipal Building, whose presumed Important Cultural Property (ICP) status the municipality sought to remove to make way for the project.
